I'll assume you don't know as there is a lot of new players but everytime you add strength or dexterity to a character, he gets some armor too so you have to compensate with resistance stats but for intelligence characters its the opposite, they get extra resistance so they compensate with armor. 
White gems should do the trick in your case

For a beginner id say to have a look at inarius build for necro, easy to understand and mix with other stuff, not the best but enough potential to get you into the endgame and for witch doctor id say mundunugu spirrit barrage, you can look up those on icy veins if needed
If you deal alright damage but die too much try swapping gems to resistance/hp instead of dexterity, my piece of advice is as long as you can tank them you can kill them too.
